request.what: Fund UTxO RPC by TxPipe for Year 2 maintenance and enhancement over 12 months, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for UTxO RPC maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The motivation states the project budget includes 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve to fund a part-time UTxO RPC maintainer at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
UTxO RPC is described as an open interface specification using Protocol Buffers with SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python for UTxO-based blockchain integration.
The proposal states that Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node have adopted UTxO RPC as a query interface, validating it as an ecosystem standard.
The project is said to maintain more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations under the Apache 2.0 license.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved framework.
The proposal asserts that the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission time.

Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are said to be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with oversight costs included in the proposal overhead.
TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

Intersect says funds will be managed using Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisignature-style role approvals, external oversight entities, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month UTxO RPC maintenance grant administered through Intersect, with stated technical scope, budget line items, governance-process references, smart-contract fund management details, and several externally checkable references, but the deterministic assessment records missing budget, feasibility, risk, alternatives, and failure-mode analysis.
